title: Planning gives an item that edits a plugin skill a check phrase the plugin portability test allows, and its worker runs that test
goal: Before the start gate, a committed item whose touches name a plugin skill or agent (skills/*/SKILL.md, agents/worker.md, or a .claude/ link to one) has no check that requires a phrase test_backlog_portable's unparameterised() refuses there (a _tools/, kb/, .claude/, AGENTS.md or _cache/ path, a bare name.py), and its brief names that test as one the worker runs (backlog.py check warns of such a check, or plan step 6 says so). Answers the SP-4jfepy6u close: ST-pogg4knc's check required 'adding a new  module' in skills/backlog/SKILL.md, which the portability test forbids, so its worker stopped on gate g1 mid-work; and ST-a5q6vaji's copied-back plugin text failed the landing gate on the same test, which its worker's tests.py run never saw.
